project_type: Greenfield Next.js 14 App Router + Supabase full-stack portal, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
build_system: Next.js 14 with App Router. Build via `npm run build` (calls `next build`). Dev server via `npm run dev`. No monorepo — single package.json at repo root.
test_framework: None required by spec. TypeScript type-check (`npx tsc --noEmit`) and Next.js build (`npx next build`) are the verification gates.
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm install` to install deps. 2) Run `npx tsc --noEmit` — must exit 0 with no type errors. 3) Run `npx next build` — must exit 0. 4) Confirm all 36 source files exist under their specified paths.
snapshot_or_generated_files: `.next/` build output produced by `npm run build`. Not committed. `node_modules/` not committed.
environment_constraints: Requires .env.local with: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ADMIN_SECRET_KEY. These are not present in repo — .env.example documents them. Never expose SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to the browser. Deployment target is Vercel.
contribution_requirements: All files go inside the workspace root: c:\Users\MANOJ PATEL R\OneDrive\Desktop\busi\emplyee. Never write outside this path. Follow the exact file paths in the plan. Commit locally on the feature branch, never push.
key_patterns: 1) Supabase client split: browser = createClientComponentClient (lib/supabase.ts), server = createServerComponentClient (lib/supabase-server.ts), admin ops = createClient with SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (inline in API routes). 2) Server Components for data-fetching pages; Client Components only for interactive forms/modals. 3) Middleware protects /admin/* (secret key check) and /employee/dashboard (session check). 4) Status auto-derived from boolean pipeline fields in PATCH API route — never manually set by employee. 5) Tailwind only, no external UI lib. 6) All enum types defined in lib/types.ts and reused across API routes and components.
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js App Router pages and API routes. components/ — React components split by portal (admin/, employee/, developer/, ui/). lib/ — Supabase client factories and shared TypeScript types. supabase/migrations/ — SQL migration for the three tables. Root — package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.js, tailwind.config.ts, middleware.ts, .env.example.
